name: Blow ~Michita Tsuki, Kaketa Tsuki~
source:
Main character is a normal high school student. During the preparation week for the culture festival a series of rapes happens right at the school campus. Who is the culprit? What are his motives? Can you get to the truth? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通高中生。文化祭准备周期间，校内接连发生强奸案。犯人是谁？动机又是什么？你能查明真相吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
